_rationale: Savings phase (ages 55-64): 50k/yr deposited via retirement_contribution — 30k pre_tax to trad-1, 20k roth to roth-1. With no wage income, pre_tax floors taxable income at 0 (no tax effect). Contributions are NOT spendable income, so afterTaxIncome=0 and netCashFlow=0 in savings years; balances grow because contributions are explicit deposits. At age 65 (index 10): trad=300k, roth=200k, total=500k. Retirement phase (ages 65-70): 15k/yr from trad (W=15k, zero tax because 15k < 18,150 deduction for single age 65+). Roth untouched. After 6 retirement years: trad=210k, roth=200k, total=410k. Probability=100% (never depletes).
